workflow.title: Test 1
workflow.summary: Navigates to Kestrel application, logs in with demo credentials, views report details and navigates back.

steps.description: Navigate to the web app at http://localhost:63837/
Type 'demo@kestrel.app' into the email input field.
Type 'test1234' into the password input field.
Click the 'Sign in' button to log into the application.
Click on a report detail link or element to view more information about an expense report.
Click the 'Back to reports' button to return to the list of all expense reports.

known_ambiguities.description: The exact link or element to click for report details is not visible in the video.

recommended_edge_cases: Ensure that all links and buttons are clearly visible before clicking.
Verify if there are any additional steps required after viewing a report detail, such as submitting changes or closing the window.
